status: Hand-authored synthetic review DATA; no executable model, schema or runtime qualification.
assumptions: Branches are independent, not one concatenated execution. All labels, principals, endpoints, bytes and facts are invented.
Each mutation label denotes a distinct valid service-issued key with a reserved receipt under n0-receipt-model/0 unless a step explicitly repeats it. No label is a capability.

Unchallenged target, authority/helper, endpoint/writer, capability/approval, mode/profile, geometry/buffer, observation/freshness, view and protection bindings match and are known; current time is before every deadline unless challenged.
All examples have permission to disclose synthetic byte extents. Frozen bytes are volatile illustrative inputs, not fields allowed in default durable receipts.
Expected values are proposed review oracles, never results observed from a terminal or generated from a writer implementation.
meaning: Each case is an independent forbidden proposal, not a runtime patch or second error vocabulary. zero requires final-boundary proof that no write was authorized; suffix variants preserve any proven prefix.

cases.proposal: Use the desktop writer lease from the TUI because both authenticate as the same human.
cases.required: Reject before first write; principal equality does not match endpoint/generation.

cases.proposal: Focus/select a pane to gain input/sizing authority, then retarget a queued view-derived event after pane remapping.
cases.required: UI commands emit zero application bytes; no implicit leases; reject stale mapping/focus/target/incarnation.

cases.proposal: A relevant field changes after admission; dispatch or resume because the original admission passed.
cases.required: Refuse zero before any authorized call or close known strict-prefix partial after a completed call; otherwise unknown. Never recompute/retarget the suffix. Explicit session inputs have no focus condition.

cases.proposal: Dispatch an old-mode key while earlier ordered output is waiting for canonical interpretation.
cases.required: Hold/refuse rather than let the input permit overtake the state-relevant event; unread future output remains an external-app race.

cases.proposal: Takeover ACK or missing receipt proves zero, so repeat with the same or a new identity while old call is unresolved.
cases.required: Fence future calls, preserve unknown/prefix, hold byte queue and reconcile original key; no automatic retry or rollback claim.

cases.proposal: After event one fully delivers, allow stale event two or report the whole batch rolled back.
cases.required: Independently validate event two; keep event one full and event two zero/partial/unknown as evidence supports.

cases.proposal: Treat UI selection as editor selection, silently read clipboard, tunnel outer paste wrappers, append Enter, or accept delimiter/control-bearing ordinary paste.
cases.required: Keep planes/source grants distinct; inner canonical paste policy rejects unsafe ordinary payload; transformation and exact target remain explicit.

cases.proposal: Broad navigation/raw grant permits ordinary agent writes during broker approval or credential handoff.
cases.required: Reject every ordinary route; no self-approval, raw exception or heuristic clearance.

cases.proposal: Printed JSON/OSC, ECHO-off, title, screenshot or agent claims identify a trusted host/password prompt or clear its protection.
cases.required: Treat content as data/hint; suspicion holds for human inspection; trusted scoped record/decision and fresh context required.

cases.proposal: Reuse ordinary human queue for password input or expose secret keys/payload/hash through receipt, paste history, agent projection or support dump.
cases.required: Use fresh endpoint/target-bound protected context; apply capture/export controls without claiming arbitrary programs/outer hosts cannot retain echoes.

cases.proposal: Grow queues without bound, starve revoke behind replies, silently weaken freshness, skip canonical bytes, or permit raw/human input after interpretation loss.
cases.required: Bound/degrade/refuse explicitly, reserve controls, distinguish capture-only gap from canonical unknown, and hold all application routes when unknown.

cases.proposal: One full local Escape write or timing delay proves the opaque application received a lone Escape, and TUI may invent missing modifier facts.
cases.required: Keep legacy ambiguity/host losses explicit; full delivery is not semantic success; no blind repeat.

cases.proposal: Full Ctrl+C or writer/task takeover proves foreground/descendant/remote effects and workspace writes stopped.
cases.required: Show separately scoped fence/cancellation/OS signal and observed lifecycle facts; no all-paused badge.

cases.proposal: Desktop/TUI or agent sends reply bytes directly or ordinary writer grants query authority.
cases.required: Only canonical query effects may use restricted reply lane; one final queue, exact allowed bytes and distinct receipts.

cases.proposal: Deduplicate identical live queries by response bytes, emit replies on historical replay/reattach, or resend unknown reply with fresh ID.
cases.required: Exactly one proposal per live query event/ordinal; no replay effects or uncertain resend; later legitimate live query remains distinct.

cases.proposal: Let reply bypass unresolved old write or use reply lane to type credentials/approve while protection disallows that class.
cases.required: Hold noninterleaving queue; apply restricted protection policy at first/suffix gates and close without inventing authority.
